messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

At 16¢ and about 400 W, the B30 runs you roughly $46 a month in power — call it a buck fifty a day.

What you get for that: it's drawing for a full block, 3.125 BTC, every ten minutes, all year, and you still own the machine after every draw. In between it stacks small amounts of Bitcoin straight to your wallet.

B30 is $899, 30 TH/s, ~50 dB, ships Nov 30. Is this your first miner?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo B30 numbers for where you live.
